shared_elements: large pale limestone monolith / slab with flat rectangular top
low-relief carved animal figures on the vertical face
elongated serpentine (snake-like) relief running down the surface
quadruped or crouching animal in profile relief
surrounding rough stone rubble and dry excavation soil
justification: Both show a pale limestone block with a flat rectangular upper element carved in shallow, rounded low relief, and each includes a downward-running serpentine motif alongside an animal in profile, set in the same rubble-strewn excavated context. The decisive difference is density and organisation: A packs its face with stacked registers of arcs, a zigzag band, birds and a disc, whereas B leaves nearly the whole surface blank with a single isolated animal and snake on the shaft.
